title: Small-bias construction work
statement: For all natural numbers $n$ and $\ell$, the executable small-bias construction work equals the field preprocessing work for dimension $\ell$ plus $2^{2\ell}$ times one more than the row work for $n$ rows and dimension $\ell$.
